name: tpu-agent-suite
description: TPU agent suite package for onboarding, optimizing, profiling, and benchmarking PyTorch models on Cloud TPUs.
author: Accelerator Agents Team

hooks.name: session-run-init
hooks.description: Initializes the session run namespace and registers RUN_ID.

hooks.name: knowledge-base-cache-sweep
hooks.description: Deletes cached knowledge-base pages no lookup will serve again, at most once a day.

hooks.name: session-end-reap
hooks.description: Cancels compute jobs the run left active once the session is over, so an executor that died mid-job does not leave a workload holding chips.

hooks.name: validate-delegate-request
hooks.description: Validates subagent request payload against the target agent's accepts schema.

hooks.name: validate-subagent-result
hooks.description: Validates a subagent result against its produces schema.

hooks.name: require-foreground-launch
hooks.description: Refuses a background delegation from an agent that has no shell: headless, the child's report would never reach it.

hooks.name: track-background-work
hooks.description: Records each background agent or command an agent launches, so a stop made while that work is still running can be told from a finished one.

hooks.name: background-ledger-cleanup
hooks.description: Drops the session's record of background launches once the session is over.

hooks.name: resume-after-quota
hooks.description: Resume a run ended by a transient backend refusal, up to 5 times with a minute between attempts.

hooks.name: record-active-skill
hooks.description: Records which package skill the main conversation is running, so its tool limit lasts for the rest of the session.

hooks.name: enforce-skill-tools
hooks.description: Blocks any main-conversation tool the active skill doesn't allow, so tpu-agent keeps delegating after the first turn. Matches every tool so unknown and new tools are blocked too.
